rule: Text sits only on graphite, slate or chalk, or as ink (#0B0E10) on a coloured chip. Never white text on a coloured chip. Ratios are WCAG 2.1, computed.

colours.name: slate
colours.use: Panels, empty board slots, button faces, portrait backgrounds.

colours.name: rule
colours.use: Borders, dividers, empty-slot outlines. Never text.

colours.name: chalk
colours.use: Card face, primary text on dark. Chalk on graphite 17.0:1, on slate 15.0:1.

colours.name: ink
colours.use: Text on chalk (17.5:1) and on every coloured chip (5.6:1 or better).

colours.name: mist
colours.use: Secondary text on dark, Neutral tribe. On graphite 8.2:1, on slate 7.3:1.

colours.name: moss
colours.use: Friendly side, positive change, the primary action (End turn, Play), brand. Ink on moss 9.7:1.

colours.name: health
colours.use: Health stat, damage numbers, enemy side, negative. Ink on health 5.8:1; health on graphite 5.6:1.

colours.name: gold
colours.use: Gold currency, prices, golden units' ring. Ink on gold 12.9:1.

colours.name: nightshade
colours.use: Nightshade status, the halving callout. Ink on nightshade 5.6:1; nightshade on graphite 5.5:1.

colours.name: frost
colours.use: Freeze button, frozen shop offers. Ink on frost 10.3:1.

colours.name: bark
colours.use: Tribe accent for ground folk: Great beasts, Hunters, Hedgerow folk, Bog folk. Ink on bark 6.7:1.

colours.name: bloom
colours.use: Tribe accent for flyers and flowers: Birds, Fairies, Hive. Ink on bloom 8.1:1.

light_and_dark: Dark only by design: competitive mobile, bright stat chips on a dark floor. A light variant would swap graphite/slate for chalk/#E4E6E0 and keep every chip colour; ink text on chips is unchanged.
